exercises.prompt: Merge transactions dengan Products melalui product_id, lalu tampilkan tiga kolom fakta dan konteks.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Pastikan kedua tabel dibaca, merge memakai product_id, dan hasilnya memuat category.
exercises.success_feedback: Benar. Kamu menambahkan konteks melalui key yang dapat diperiksa.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
products = pd.read_csv("products.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
sales = transactions.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
summary = sales.groupby("category", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum().sort_values("category")
print(summary)
